question: ______must be ascribed for the sake of convenience and is the size of a part in relation to which all limits of variation are determined.
solution:
The correct answer is __Nominal size.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Nominal size__ is the size assigned for the sake of convenience.
 
• It is the size of a part in relation to which all limits of variation are determined.
 
• Nominal size serves as the reference size from which tolerances are applied.
 
• It is not necessarily the actual size but a rounded or standard value used in design and manufacturing.
 
• It helps engineers and manufacturers communicate dimensions uniformly and effectively.
 
• Nominal size is commonly used in fields like mechanical engineering, construction, and machining.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Actual size:**

 
 
• It refers to the measured size of a part, which may slightly differ from the nominal size due to tolerances and manufacturing variations.
 
 
 
• **Basic size:**
 
 
• The size to which tolerances are added to determine the allowable variation in part dimensions.
 
 
 
• **Tolerances:**
 
 
• Permissible limits of variation in a physical dimension, ensuring parts fit and function properly.
